'''Meglumine''', originally known as '''Ord Meglumine''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Meglumine system/Legends|Meglumine system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. An [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]], Ord Meglumine was used by the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a staging point for their assault on [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] during the [[Great Northern Crusade]] in [[11,884 BBY]].

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TK329]] was serving on the Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], which had a stopover near Meglumine. A small number of the ship's crew went planetside, while the rest enjoyed some recreation time aboard the ship.<ref name="Twitter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meglumine was mentioned in an entry on [[Stormtrooper TK 329 (TK329) on Twitter|@TK329]], a [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account from the perspective of an [[in-universe]] stormtrooper. On the [[Jedi Council Forums]], [[Jason Fry]] confirmed that Meglumine was a canonical planet.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30491337|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-10-13|time=5:54 PM}}</ref>
